facts.summary: PDS online services may be accessible through a mobile phone using the official State or Union Territory PDS portal when the applicable service supports mobile access.
access: Open the official PDS portal of the concerned State or Union Territory using a mobile web browser.
Use the mobile-compatible interface or official mobile application if one is provided by the concerned authority.
Follow the authentication and verification process required by the applicable service.
facts.mobile_website: A PDS website may support mobile-browser access, but mobile compatibility depends on the portal implementation.
facts.mobile_application: Some PDS authorities may provide an official mobile application or mobile-specific service. Availability depends on the concerned State/UT.
possible_services: Other services made available through the applicable mobile-compatible portal.
facts.authentication: Mobile access may require OTP, beneficiary authentication or other verification depending on the service.
technical_requirements: A supported mobile browser or official application where applicable.
A device capable of accessing the required portal or service.
facts.state_specific: Mobile availability, supported services, applications and technical requirements can differ between States and Union Territories.
security: Use only official government PDS websites or applications.
Do not install applications from unknown or unofficial sources.
Do not share OTPs, passwords or other authentication credentials.
important_notes: Do not assume that every PDS service is available on mobile.
Do not assume that every State/UT has an official mobile application.
Do not provide an unofficial application or website.
For State-specific mobile access, the concerned State/UT must be identified.

faqs.question: Can I access PDS services from my mobile phone?
faqs.answer: PDS services may be accessible through a mobile browser or official mobile application when the concerned State/UT system supports mobile access.

faqs.question: Can I use the PDS portal on a mobile browser?
faqs.answer: Mobile-browser access depends on the implementation and compatibility of the concerned State/UT PDS portal.

faqs.question: Is there a PDS mobile app?
faqs.answer: An official mobile application may be available for some PDS systems, but availability depends on the concerned State or Union Territory.

faqs.question: Can I apply for a ration card using my phone?
faqs.answer: This depends on whether the concerned State/UT provides an online application service that supports mobile access.

faqs.question: Is mobile access available for every PDS service?
faqs.answer: No. The services available through mobile access depend on the concerned State/UT PDS system.

faqs.question: Is it safe to use a PDS service on mobile?
faqs.answer: Use only official government PDS portals or applications and never share OTPs, passwords or other authentication credentials.

organizations: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
Concerned State or Union Territory Food and Civil Supplies Authority
